annotations.title: Pre-Flight EVM Transaction Simulator (Zero API Key)

description: [ZERO API KEY REQUIRED] Pre-flight EVM transaction simulator. Dry-runs eth_call + eth_estimateGas on Base or Ethereum before signing/broadcasting, decodes any custom revert reason, detects unlimited drainer approvals, and outputs recommendedAgentAction ('EXECUTE_SAFE', 'ABORT_WILL_REVERT', or 'ABORT_DRAINER_APPROVAL').

value.description: Hex or wei value to send (default '0x0')

name: simulate_transaction_preflight
